Hwaro ships with a broad set of built-in features, and no plugins are required. All features are configured through `config.toml` and work out of the box once enabled.

## At a Glance

**SEO & Discovery** — Sitemap, RSS/Atom feeds, robots.txt, OpenGraph, Twitter Cards, structured data (JSON-LD), auto-generated OG images, and llms.txt.

**Content** — Syntax highlighting, search index generation, pagination, markdown extensions (footnotes, task lists, math, mermaid), series, related posts, named navigation menus, extra output formats, pages generated from data, and git metadata.

**Performance** — Incremental builds, streaming builds for large sites, asset pipeline with minification and fingerprinting, a built-in Sass compiler, image processing with responsive variants, WebP output and LQIP placeholders, and cache busting.

**Files & Environment** — Environment variables, environment-specific config overrides, auto-includes for CSS/JS, local and remote data, content file publishing, and build hooks.

**Platform** — Multilingual support, versioned docs, PWA, AMP, Content Security Policy, privacy mode, and built-in deployment to multiple targets.
